Test Title: Verify Admin can create a main category when a valid category name is sent with no parent
Precondition:
1. App running and data reset (POST /api/test/reset)
2. Admin token obtained from POST /api/admin/auth/login
3. No category named "Cacti" exists
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /api/admin/categories with headers Authorization: Bearer <admin token> and Content-Type: application/json, and the test data as the body
Expected Result:
1.1 Validate status code is 201
1.2 Validate success is true
1.3 Validate message is "Category created successfully"
1.4 Validate data.name is "Cacti" and data.parentId is null

Test Title: Verify Admin cannot create a main category when the category name has 2 characters
Precondition:
1. App running and data reset
2. Admin token obtained
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /api/admin/categories with the admin token and the test data
Expected Result:
1.1 Validate status code is 400
1.2 Validate errors.name is "Category name must be between 3 and 10 characters"

Test Title: Verify Client cannot view the category list when a Client token is used
Precondition:
1. App running and data reset
2. Client token obtained from POST /api/client/public/auth/login (user / User@123)
Test Steps: 1. Send GET /api/admin/categories with header Authorization: Bearer <client token>
Expected Result:
1.1 Validate status code is 403
1.2 Validate message is "You do not have permission to access this resource"

Test Title: Verify Admin can create a sub-category when a main category is selected as the parent
Precondition:
1. Data reset
2. Logged in to the Admin App as admin
3. Browser at /admin/categories
Test Steps:
1. Click Add Category
2. Enter the category name from the test data
3. Select the parent from the test data
4. Click Save
Expected Result:
4.1 Validate the user is redirected to /admin/categories
4.2 Validate the message "Category created successfully" is shown
4.3 Validate the list shows Bonsai with parent Outdoor

Test Title: Verify Admin sees a validation message when saving a category without a name
Precondition:
1. Logged in to the Admin App as admin
2. Browser at /admin/categories/add
Test Steps:
1. Leave Category name empty
2. Click Save
Expected Result:
2.1 Validate the user stays on /admin/categories/add
2.2 Validate "Category name is required" is shown below Category name

Test Title: Verify the category is kept when Admin cancels the delete confirmation
Precondition:
1. Data reset
2. Logged in to the Admin App as admin
3. Browser at /admin/categories
Test Steps:
1. Click Delete on the Seasonal row
2. Click Cancel
Expected Result:
1.1 Validate the confirmation "Are you sure you want to delete Seasonal?" is shown
2.1 Validate the confirmation closes
2.2 Validate Seasonal is still listed
